items.title: Apple Event 2026 impact: Redington shares jump 5% after Apple unveils first-ever foldable iPhone
items.description: Apple’s entry into the foldable smartphone market could benefit Redington, a key Apple distribution partner in India and other markets. Analysts expect the launch to boost consumer awareness and confidence in foldables, although Samsung is likely to retain its dominance in the near term. IDC expects Apple to ship around 10 million units in the first 12 months.

items.title: Ather Energy shares rise 3% as Nomura raises target price; stock up nearly 200% in 1 year
items.description: Ather Energy shares rose after Nomura raised its target to Rs 1,926, citing faster EV adoption, the Konarc launch and stronger growth prospects. The brokerage retained its Buy rating and raised its EV penetration forecast for FY30.

items.title: Aegis Logistics among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On September 9, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, suggesting strengthening momentum in the price of the stock. This can indicate potential upward movement and may be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Vodafone Idea shares price in focus as Jefferies initiates coverage with Buy rating. Why are analysts bullish?
items.description: Jefferies has initiated coverage on Vodafone Idea with a ‘Buy’ rating and a Rs 20 price target, implying 29% upside. The brokerage expects subscriber stabilisation, tariff hikes and operating leverage to drive recovery, with cash EBITDA forecast to grow at a 25% CAGR through FY31. However, funding needs and execution remain key risks to the turnaround.

items.title: Sensex trades flat, Nifty near 23,450 as oil prices top $100 a barrel. What’s ahead?
items.description: Thursday marked a mixed start for Indian benchmark indices in light of previous losses. The Sensex dipped, while the Nifty edged up slightly. The performance across broader markets reflected this divergence, with midcaps declining and smallcaps rising. Higher crude oil prices may challenge energy-sensitive sectors, while defensive sectors, particularly FMCG and pharmaceuticals, are expected to remain robust.

items.title: Explained: 2 key developments driving RVNL, Ircon and other railway stocks higher
items.description: Five railway multitracking projects worth around Rs 10,021 crore have been approved across South India, adding about 540 km to the Indian Railways network. Three more projects worth Rs 10,783 crore were cleared across five states. The projects are expected to boost rail capacity, ease congestion, improve connectivity and support incremental freight movement over the coming years.

items.title: Adani Power among 3 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.description: On September 9, three stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level towards the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy IREDA, Kalyan Jewellers among more than 100 stocks for dividends. Do you own any?
items.description: Under Sebi's T+1 settlement cycle, investors need to purchase a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action. Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy the shares so that they are credited to their accounts by the record date (September 11), making them eligible for the dividend.

items.title: PVR Inox's Rs 300 crore buyback opens today: How much return can retail investors expect?
items.description: Under PVR Inox's buyback offer, eligible shareholders in the reserved category for small shareholders are entitled to tender 9 equity shares for every 157 equity shares held as on the record date (September 4). For shareholders falling under the general category, the buyback entitlement has been fixed at 21 equity shares for every 1,108 equity shares held on the record date.

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 5 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty 200 pack, five stocks saw their closing prices fall below their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on September 9, according to technical scan data from StockEdge. Trading below the 200 DMA is generally considered a negative signal, as it suggests that a stock’s price is below its long-term trend. The 200 DMA is a widely used technical indicator that helps traders assess the overall trend of a stock.

items.title: JPMorgan unit, Mansi Share gets nod to trade, but can’t participate in CAS
items.description: Sebi has removed trading restrictions on Copthall Mauritius Investment and Mansi Share after they deposited questionable gains with the regulator last month. This decision aligns with Sebi's directive to block certain funds from their accounts. Nevertheless, they will still face limitations when participating in the closing auction session, as investigations into claims of market manipulation persist.

items.title: BSE chief says most players still avoid new closing auction
items.description: BSE CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy says most market participants are yet to embrace the new closing auction system, with only a handful of institutions participating a month after its launch. The muted uptake suggests the mechanism is still grappling with initial teething issues.

items.title: ESDS Software surges 235% in 4 sessions as AI infra fever grips markets
items.description: After the recent launch of its IPO, ESDS Software Solutions has seen a noteworthy increase in stock performance, indicating strong investor confidence in the expansion of India's data-centre landscape. This shift is largely due to the soaring demand for cloud technology and AI services. By 2030, India's data-centre capacity is anticipated to grow significantly, fueled by favorable policies and investments in renewable energy sources.

items.title: India’s niche brokers see sharp rise in active trading users
items.description: The landscape of Indian brokerage firms is changing as smaller platforms enjoy a boom in clientele, leaving larger firms in a state of flux. Experienced traders are gravitating toward these nimble, innovative platforms that emphasize robust trading capabilities rather than just competitive pricing. In contrast, giants such as Groww, Zerodha, and Angel One are seeing a notable decline in user growth.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Wipro, ICICI Bank, Coal India and Hindustan Zinc
items.description: Indian equity markets experienced a decline on Wednesday, extending their recent corrective phase. Several companies, including Reliance Industries and Coal India, are expected to be in focus. Railway stocks will be watched after the government approved five new projects costing over ₹10,000 crore. Hindustan Zinc signed a six-year contract for electric trucks, while Wipro launched a new cybersecurity center.

items.title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
items.description: The Indian stock markets were under considerable selling pressure on Wednesday, highlighted by Brent crude oil prices crossing the $100 mark. This uptick in oil prices dampened investor morale, prompting foreign portfolio investors to sell off shares. Conversely, domestic institutional investors capitalized on the situation to purchase stocks. Coupled with these changes, the Indian Rupee faced depreciation against the US dollar.

items.title: BSE suffers outage, Zerodha users complain of F&O price not reflecting
items.description: On September 10, the BSE faced a brief disruption that impacted various cash segment partitions and specific scrips. Once the exchange addressed the technical glitch, regular operations were restored. However, traders using Zerodha reported issues with outdated prices and order placements on certain contracts. Although Zerodha confirmed the resolution, some users experienced lingering technical difficulties.

items.title: Global Market: Blackstone acquires majority stake in South Korea logistics park
items.description: Blackstone has secured a dominant share in Sanha Logistics Park II, located in South Korea. This strategic acquisition reinforces Blackstone's foothold in the East Asian market, with the logistics park slated for completion by 2028. Management of the development and assets will remain under ESR. This initiative enhances Blackstone's logistics real estate portfolio throughout the region.

items.title: 11 stocks that recorded profit margins above 10% for 4 straight quarters; surge up to 120%
items.description: A recent analysis of the BSE 500 shows that several companies have consistently maintained healthy profit margins, reflecting strong operational efficiency and supporting sustainable growth. Such consistency can also help strengthen investor confidence in these companies. Our analysis identified 155 companies in the BSE 500 index that maintained a profit margin of above 10% for four consecutive quarters through the quarter ended June 2026. The analysis excludes banking and financial stocks.In terms of stock performance, 11 stocks from this list delivered impressive gains of 70% to 120% over the past year. Of these, four stocks turned multibaggers, more than doubling investors’ wealth. The performance highlights the strong market returns delivered by companies that have also demonstrated a consistent track record of profitability. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: HFCL shares hit lower circuit after 240% rally in 2026. What technical charts now indicate
items.description: HFCL shares hit the 5% lower circuit on Thursday, extending their two-day decline to 7% despite a 240% rally so far in 2026. The stock is currently consolidating in the Rs 257–218 range, with technical indicators pointing to a sideways bias, according to SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah.

items.title: Losing money in Nifty? 8 beaten-down largecap stocks see promoters increase stake in 2026
items.description: Promoters raised stakes in eight Nifty largecaps despite stock declines in 2026, with Jio Financial, Bharti Airtel and Reliance among the companies seeing higher holdings. The moves suggest continued promoter confidence amid a challenging phase for largecap equities.

items.title: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 30% in 2 days, jump 80% since debut. What lies ahead?
items.description: Molbio Diagnostics shares have surged nearly 30% in two sessions, extending their post-listing gains to around 80% from the IPO price. The sharp rally comes as the newly listed company reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance, swinging to a profit of Rs 58.75 crore from a loss in the year-ago quarter.

items.title: Dilip Buildcon shares rally 12% on bagging Rs 1,800 crore LPG pipeline project
items.description: Dilip Buildcon shares rallied after the company received an LOI from PNGRB to develop an LPG pipeline from Paradip to Raipur. The project gives the company an exclusive licence to develop, finance, construct and operate the pipeline, as well as levy and collect transportation tariffs up to the designated delivery point.

items.title: Jefferies says Adani Enterprises is the ‘platform behind platforms’ with 4 major growth levers
items.description: Jefferies retained a Buy rating on Adani Enterprises with a Rs 3,830 target, citing its infrastructure incubation model and strong growth potential. The brokerage expects a 23% EBITDA CAGR through FY31, led by airports, data centres and ANIL.

items.title: Why Jefferies is bullish on Manipal Hospitals after its ₹9,000 crore acquisition spree
items.description: Manipal Hospitals’ acquisition-led expansion is entering a key phase, with Jefferies initiating coverage with a Buy rating and Rs 870 target. The brokerage expects strong earnings growth, driven by the turnaround of Sahyadri Hospitals, new bed additions, higher utilisation and operating leverage. However, execution risks at Sahyadri and intensifying competition in Bengaluru remain key concerns for the investment case.

items.title: IRB Infrastructure shares rally 8% as August toll revenue surges 25% YoY to Rs 807 crore
items.description: Shares of IRB Infrastructure Developers surged up to 8% after the company reported a 25% YoY rise in toll revenue to Rs 807 crore in August 2026, supported by strong traffic growth and tariff revisions. Key projects, including the Mumbai-Pune Expressway and Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway, also recorded healthy revenue growth, offering a positive operational trigger for the stock.

items.title: Enviro Infra Engineers shares rise 5% on Rs 224 crore wind EPC order from Tata Power RE
items.description: Enviro Infra Engineers shares sharply after its step-down subsidiary Suyog Urja received a Rs 224.19 crore LOI from Tata Power Renewable Energy for EPC works on a 180 MW NTPC wind project in Maharashtra. The contract covers foundation, balance-of-plant and transmission-line works, strengthening the company’s renewable energy portfolio.

items.title: Coforge shares rise 2% as Nuvama, other brokerages say concerns around Chairman's resignation are overdone
items.description: Coforge shares recovered after brokerages retained Buy calls, saying concerns over Chairman Om Prakash Bhatt’s resignation are overdone. Nuvama and Motilal Oswal see limited business impact and remain positive on the company’s growth outlook.

items.title: ESDS Software shares plunge 8% after skyrocketing 235% from IPO price in 4 days. What lies ahead?
items.description: ESDS Software Solutions shares fell sharply on Thursday after surging 235% from their IPO price in four sessions. While strong demand for cloud, AI infrastructure, cybersecurity and digitalisation supports the company’s long-term prospects, analysts warn of near-term profit-taking, execution risks and stretched valuations after the stock’s sharp post-listing rally.

items.title: Ola Electric shares surge 7%. What’s triggering the sharp uptick in EV major?
items.description: Ola Electric shares rallied on Thursday as value buying emerged after three consecutive sessions of decline. Around 6.87 crore shares worth Rs 270 crore were traded. The buying interest followed the company’s launch of its first batch of dealer-operated stores.

items.title: Brokerages initiate coverage on BSE, Adani Power and 6 other stocks,  see up to 60% upside. Own any?
items.description: A host of domestic and global brokerages have initiated coverage on select Indian stocks across sectors such as banks and consumer discretionary. Analysts are bullish on major names such as Adani Power, BSE and PhysicsWallah, among others, and forecast strong upside from current market levels. Here is a list of eight stocks on which brokerages have initiated coverage.

items.title: SME IPO jackpot or 50:50 gamble? 21 multibagger stocks mask a harsher reality
items.description: This year's SME IPO market in India offers a varied landscape for investors. While twenty-one stocks emerged as multibaggers, numerous others significantly lagged behind. The median return for investors is a modest 3.9 percent, underscoring that impressive gains are largely attributable to a handful of standout performers. As such, careful stock selection is essential for those venturing into the SME IPO segment.
